data.gender_notes: Adwa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'Adwa', which means a grievance, a complaint, or a cause for which one may make a complaint. It is a name that speaks of standing up for oneself and one's rights, and of having the strength and resilience to weather the storms of life. The name Adwa carries the meaning “Grievance, complaint” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Adwa usually hope their child will grow to embody grievance, complaint and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Adwa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Grievance, complaint.”
